text: Corporate Governance｜SHIMANO Corporate Site IR Corporate Governance Corporate Governance The Company has positioned corporate governance as an important management priority, and is committed to the enhancement of corporate governance from a long-term perspective through the establishment of a framework for swift and appropriate decision-making and execution of operations, as well as a fair monitoring and supervisory system. Inspired by our mission - "To create new value and promote health and happiness through the enjoyment of nature and the world around us" - we will continue to offer captivating products without neglecting our duty as a development-oriented manufacturer. Additionally, through our philosophies of upholding sustained growth as a value creating company, we will strive to enhance corporate value for all of our stakeholders including our shareholders/investors, customers, business partners, society and employees. Furthermore, by engaging in open business management we will raise the transparency of management, respect the rights of our shareholders, and fulfill our fiduciary responsibility and accountability.
